title: Second Meet with Gladstone after Curfew

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: You did it! You destroyed my old traps, every one!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You did it! You destroyed my old traps, every one!

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: The rats told me. Didn't you feel their eyes watching you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The rats told me. Didn't you feel their eyes watching you?

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: Yes, of course. The rats say that Quince Crogan hides a secret in his shop...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, of course. The rats say that Quince Crogan hides a secret in his shop...

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: And the rats will help you in return! They told me that Quince Crogan hid a secret in his shop...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And the rats will help you in return! They told me that Quince Crogan hid a secret in his shop...

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: I'd say that's a pretty clear message considering they're rodents.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd say that's a pretty clear message considering they're rodents.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: Many. The Rat King could tell you anything you wished to know. And I have come up with a plan to find him...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Many. The Rat King could tell you anything you wished to know. And I have come up with a plan to find him...

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: Cheese.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cheese.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: Not just any cheese. Green Reeker. The most pungent cheese ever created. Highly flammable. Illegal in seventeen districts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not just any cheese. Green Reeker. The most pungent cheese ever created. Highly flammable. Illegal in seventeen districts.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: You were so good at sneaking before. If anyone can get hold of a little bit of Reeker, surely you can.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You were so good at sneaking before. If anyone can get hold of a little bit of Reeker, surely you can.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: I don't know... if I did I would have tried myself. Ask one of the illegal traders. They keep their salty secrets close.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know... if I did I would have tried myself. Ask one of the illegal traders. They keep their salty secrets close.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: Humph. Well, the rats thank you anyway. They won't forget.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Humph. Well, the rats thank you anyway. They won't forget.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: The rats, don't you feel their thankful eyes on you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The rats, don't you feel their thankful eyes on you?

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: Oh, rats don't play. And they don't lie. But they don't understand the concept of property or locks. Or death.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, rats don't play. And they don't lie. But they don't understand the concept of property or locks. Or death.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: The rats are not very good with such details, considering they're rodents.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The rats are not very good with such details, considering they're rodents.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How do you know...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do you know...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, happy to help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, happy to help.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about my payment?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about my payment?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can the rats be more specific?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can the rats be more specific?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can the rats be more specific?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can the rats be more specific?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do they know any other secrets?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do they know any other secrets?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do they know any other secrets?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do they know any other secrets?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Which is?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Which is?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Cheese?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cheese?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let me guess: you want me to find some?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let me guess: you want me to find some?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Let me guess: you want me to find some?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Let me guess: you want me to find some?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not risking my neck for cheese.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not risking my neck for cheese.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not risking my neck for cheese.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not risking my neck for cheese.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Piece of cake. Where do I get it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Piece of cake. Where do I get it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Piece of cake. Where do I get it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Piece of cake. Where do I get it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I told you I would!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I told you I would!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have the gnawing feeling I've been played.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have the gnawing feeling I've been played.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have the gnawing feeling I've been played.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have the gnawing feeling I've been played.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The man is dead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The man is dead.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Gold?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gold?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So I'm not getting paid before ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So I'm not getting paid before ...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So I'm not getting paid before ...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So I'm not getting paid before ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right.
